content.text:
I tidied the code a little and pushed it to the PR branch as `2a0d17a`. Nothing behaves differently. Locally, the checks, the full test suite and the coverage run all pass; I didn't wait for CI on the new commit.

- **`src/durable/sections.ts`:** removed a leftover doc comment from the old `GUIDELINES_SECTION` that sat above `COLLAPSE_GUIDELINE`.
- **`src/durable/context/collapse.ts`:**
  - The line, the edits and the provenance now share one list of entry IDs instead of building it twice.
  - The size is one sum over the call and its results.
  - The `keepRuns - 1` slice has a comment saying why it subtracts one: the run that just answered counts as a kept run.
- **`src/durable/context/edits.ts`:** made `describeCall` easier to read. A call is named by its tool and label when the line has several calls, and by its label alone when it has one.
- **`src/durable/present.ts`:** added the missing braces on the early return in `digestTypeScriptCall`.
- **`test/support/durable-harness.ts`:** rewrote the `fail` check from a comparison of two booleans to a plain either/or (`options.fail ? status === "done" : status !== "done"`).
- **`test/durable/context.test.ts`:** put the `{ fail: true }` argument back on one line.

The tidy-up is +12/−12 lines across six files.

#397 still has the `pi:pit-from-pr` label, so the next run here will load `2a0d17a`. Remove it before merging if you want runs here to go back to `v0.37.0`.
